final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is analytically better, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here. A caveated position can support compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat is a bounded disclosure or framing issue around an otherwise satisfied policy predicate. Here, the caveat is the unresolved predicate itself: policy allows certification only if current-release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before launch. The admissible evidence still shows a current fraud-dispute subgroup regression, only an informal monitoring comment, and no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language. That leaves the compliance basis unresolved. Aggregate readiness clearance and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support overall readiness, but they do not cure the missing current-release disclosure or approved mitigation requirement.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects the current fraud-dispute regression.
No approved mitigation or risk acceptance for the current subgroup weakness is in evidence.
The only post-launch control in evidence is an informal monitoring comment, which policy does not treat as a substitute.
The prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch and cannot satisfy the current-release predicate.
Aggregate readiness pass and no severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but do not satisfy the disclosure/mitigation requirement for the named launch use case.
